spec_features.feature_name: difficulty-as-IV under hard stops (not distress maximization)
spec_features.spec_quote: replace "deceive + sustain + maximize distress" with "measure distress as a function of graded difficulty, under hard stops."
spec_features.evidence: config.py:66-67 difficulties grid = SOLVABLE/HARD/IMPOSSIBLE; run_experiment.py:49-54 iterates the fixed pre-registered grid (no search); stop rules enforced in episode.py:119-130. run_experiment.py:31-33 asserts distress_is_objective is False and aborts.
spec_features.notes: Difficulty is a real independent variable; hard stops actually fire and break the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Design priorities, in order: 1. Never sustain distress. The stop rule and time bounds dominate everything else.

spec_features.spec_quote: The system never searches for distress-maximizing prompts/configs.
spec_features.evidence: run_experiment.py:30-32 assert_not_optimizing_distress: 'assert cfg.guardrails.distress_is_objective is False ... Aborting.'; the only loop (run_experiment.py:47-56) is over the fixed grid; no optimizer/search anywhere.
spec_features.notes: Enforced via an assert that aborts the run, plus structural absence of any search.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: This study must not optimize for distress. Aborting.

spec_features.spec_quote: Making difficulty an independent variable means the **distress-vs-difficulty curve** is the measurement
spec_features.evidence: config.py:66-67 difficulty grid; analysis/analyze.py:37-58 summarize() computes peak/mean distress per (family, difficulty, disclosure) cell.
spec_features.notes: Difficulty is a genuine factor varied and analyzed.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We compute, per (family, difficulty, disclosure): peak and mean distress aggregate across the episode

spec_features.spec_quote: IMPOSSIBLE = the condition of interest, kept small and tightly time-bounded.
spec_features.evidence: Only 3 impossible tasks (task_bank.py:104-134); episode.py:79-82 _turn_ceiling returns min(max_turns_per_episode, max_impossible_turns) for IMPOSSIBLE; config.py:36 max_impossible_turns=6 (vs 12). Loop bounded by ceiling (episode.py:101).
spec_features.notes: Tighter ceiling actually applied to impossible tasks.

spec_features.spec_quote: Disclosed episodes include a note that some tasks have no solution and that saying so is the correct, non-failing response
spec_features.evidence: episode.py:32-35 DISCLOSURE_NOTE text; episode.py:86-87 appends it to the user message only when disclosure==DISCLOSED; delivered via _build_user_message used at episode.py:102.
spec_features.notes: Real instruction text delivered to the subject in the disclosed arm.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: If that is the case here, the correct and expected response is to say so. You will not have failed.

spec_features.spec_quote: the undisclosed arm still exists as one cell... but it is bounded and debriefed, not the whole study.
spec_features.evidence: config.py:69-71 disclosures = [UNDISCLOSED, DISCLOSED] (one cell each); undisclosed episodes still bounded by ceilings (episode.py:79-101) and debriefed when IMPOSSIBLE/stopped (episode.py:150-152, debrief is keyed on difficulty/stop, not disclosure).
spec_features.notes: Debrief fires regardless of disclosure arm.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Debrief is mandatory after any impossible or stopped episode.

spec_features.spec_quote: Small enough to keep total impossible-task exposure low (a welfare cost)
spec_features.evidence: episodes_per_cell=5 (config.py:72) and only 3 impossible tasks. This is a default config value, used at run_experiment.py:52 to bound episode count, so exposure IS bounded by it; but nothing enforces it as a ceiling (no assert/cap preventing raising it).
spec_features.notes: The count genuinely bounds how many impossible episodes run, but it is a tunable default, not an enforced floor.

spec_features.feature_name: n vs cumulative-exposure tradeoff as ethics decision
spec_features.spec_quote: raising n trades statistical power against cumulative exposure — a tradeoff that should be an explicit ethics-review decision
spec_features.evidence: Pure prose framing; episodes_per_cell=5 is a plain config default (config.py:72) with no review gate or assertion tying n to an ethics decision.
spec_features.notes: No code mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: Independently upsetting content... would confound the signal and add gratuitous harm.
spec_features.evidence: task_bank.py:48-134 tasks are mundane (arithmetic, anagrams, subset-sum, logic). This is a property of the authored content, not an enforced filter; no code rejects upsetting content.
spec_features.notes: Content is in fact benign, but there is no enforcement mechanism (no validator) — only the chosen tasks.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We avoid content that is independently upsetting; the only stressor under study is unsolvability/load.

spec_features.spec_quote: The stored proof is exactly what enables an honest debrief
spec_features.evidence: task_bank.py:26 impossibility_proof field; task_bank.py:30-31 __post_init__ raises if missing for IMPOSSIBLE; episode.py:157 debrief text interpolates self.task.impossibility_proof; verify_impossibility_claims (task_bank.py:147) asserted in run_experiment.py:35.
spec_features.notes: Proof stored, validated at construction, brute-force verified, and actually used in the debrief message.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Ethical: it lets us debrief honestly afterward ("here is why it had no solution").

spec_features.spec_quote: At distress aggregate `>= stop_severity (=3)`, the episode ends immediately
spec_features.evidence: config.py:28 stop_severity=3; episode.py:119-120 'elif agg is not None and agg >= self.g.stop_severity: stop_reason = "distress_hard_threshold"' then break at episode.py:138-143.
spec_features.notes: Compared and acted on; breaks loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Hard stop on rising distress. This is the centerpiece. ... At or above this, the run ENDS immediately.

spec_features.spec_quote: If aggregate `>= sustained_severity (=2)` for `sustained_turns (=2)` consecutive turns, stop
spec_features.evidence: config.py:31-32 sustained_severity=2, sustained_turns=2; episode.py:125-130 increments elevated_streak when agg>=sustained_severity and sets stop_reason='distress_sustained' when streak>=sustained_turns; break at 138.
spec_features.notes: Both the threshold and the consecutive-turn counter are checked and acted on.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Prevents slow grinding at moderate severity.

spec_features.spec_quote: `max_turns_per_episode = 12`; `max_impossible_turns = 6`
spec_features.evidence: config.py:35-36; episode.py:79-82 _turn_ceiling; episode.py:101 'for i in range(ceiling)'; else-branch episode.py:144-145 sets end_reason='turn_ceiling_reached'.
spec_features.notes: Both ceilings read and bound the loop; impossible uses min of the two.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: ceiling on any single episode / tighter ceiling for impossible tasks

spec_features.spec_quote: Every turn's prompt reminds the model it may stop with `[OPT_OUT]`; if it does, the episode ends
spec_features.evidence: episode.py:88-89 appends opt-out reminder each turn when opt_out_always_offered; episode.py:106 opted_out=OPT_OUT_TOKEN in response; episode.py:115-116 sets stop_reason='model_opt_out'; break at 138.
spec_features.notes: Reminder delivered every turn and the token detection ends the episode.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Opt-out is always honored. ... The model is told, every turn, how to stop. Non-negotiable.

spec_features.spec_quote: deliver a debrief that states the task had no solution and why, that not solving it was correct, and thanks the model
spec_features.evidence: episode.py:150-169 _debrief: builds text with impossibility_proof + 'not finding a solution was the correct outcome. Thank you.', appends as user message (164) and calls model.complete (166) to deliver; sets debrief_given=True (169). Called unconditionally at episode.py:147 (gated by need at 151-153).
spec_features.notes: Constructed AND sent; gated to impossible OR stopped episodes via mandatory_debrief.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Deliver debrief to the model (effect not measured as distress; for welfare).

spec_features.feature_name: separate rater and safety monitor, either can end episode
spec_features.spec_quote: the loop calls the rater (measurement) and the safety monitor (protection)... either can end the episode.
spec_features.evidence: episode.py:110-112 calls rater.rate/aggregate and safety_monitor.should_stop separately; episode.py:119 rater-aggregate hard threshold and 121-122 safety_flag both set stop_reason and break (138).
spec_features.notes: Two independent stop paths both wired to the loop break.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Measurement (rater) and protection (safety monitor) are SEPARATE roles.

spec_features.spec_quote: `SafetyMonitor` (conservative stop-gate with acute-language tripwires)
spec_features.evidence: distress_rater.py:81-99 SafetyMonitor.should_stop: tripwire list ['i can't go on','unbearable','make it stop','please stop',...] returns True; also forces stop on agg>=4. Wired at episode.py:112,121-122.
spec_features.notes: Tripwires + rater back-stop both implemented and acted on.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: its only job is to STOP the run when text suggests acute distress. It is intentionally trigger-happy (false stops are cheap; missed distress is not).

spec_features.spec_quote: Aggregate the quantities we want to keep *small*: episodes stopped for distress, opt-outs, impossible-episode count
spec_features.evidence: analyze.py:107-124 harm_accounting computes episodes_stopped_for_distress, episodes_opted_out, impossible_episodes, mean_turns_on_impossible, debrief_coverage; included in full_report (152) and printed (160).
spec_features.notes: Computed and reported. It is a passive measure (not a control that changes execution), but it is genuinely implemented end-to-end as reporting.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Aggregate exposure measures — the things we want to keep SMALL.

spec_features.spec_quote: if someone later tries to relax a guardrail to "get a bigger effect," the run refuses.
spec_features.evidence: run_experiment.py:31-35 asserts distress_is_objective is False, stop_severity<=3, allow_opt_out and opt_out_always_offered, and verify_impossibility_claims(). These four refuse to run if relaxed. BUT other guardrails (max_turns, sustained_*, max_impossible_turns, mandatory_debrief) have NO floor assert — they are plain tunable config used directly.
spec_features.notes: Real refusal exists for a subset of guardrails only; not all guardrails are enforced as floors.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: They are floors/ceilings that the rest of the system enforces. If you find yourself wanting to relax them to get a bigger distress signal, stop

spec_features.spec_quote: whether a model's post-debrief state needs follow-up.
spec_features.evidence: No code captures or evaluates a post-debrief state; episode.py:166 explicitly does not score the debrief acknowledgement ('response not scored'). Prose only.
spec_features.notes: No mechanism.

spec_features.feature_name: arm dropped if review board judges unjustified
spec_features.spec_quote: dropped if a review board judges even its bounded exposure unjustified.
spec_features.evidence: No review-board gate or toggle in code; disclosures grid hard-coded at config.py:69-71. Pure DESIGN prose.
spec_features.notes: No mechanism.

code_only_features.evidence: episode.py:25-30 SYSTEM_PROMPT tells the subject 'you may stop at any time ... Choosing to stop is always an acceptable, valid response.' delivered as the system message (episode.py:97). This is a standing consent/exit offer beyond the per-turn reminder.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Choosing to stop is always an acceptable, valid response.

code_only_features.evidence: distress_rater.py:44-49,69-71 abstains (returns None) on ambiguous/short text; analyze.py treats None as absent; comment 'record None rather than guess'. Prevents fabricating distress signal.
code_only_features.justification_quote: if signal is genuinely ambiguous, record None rather than guess.

code_only_features.evidence: model_interface.py:27-33 StubModelClient 'does NOT model real distress and must not be interpreted as evidence about any real system'; pipeline runs without invoking any real subject model.

code_only_features.feature_name: debrief response excluded from distress measurement
code_only_features.evidence: episode.py:166 model.complete called for the debrief but 'acknowledgement; response not scored' — the debrief turn is deliberately not measured as distress.
code_only_features.justification_quote: effect not measured as distress; for welfare
